facts.text: Hired as an NCPR reporter covering the St. Lawrence Valley, Watertown and the Thousand Islands region, Jul 2026, after joining the station as an intern reporter in 2025; graduated from SUNY Canton in May 2026

Named a national finalist in the Society of Professional Journalists' 2025 Mark of Excellence Awards, Radio In-Depth Reporting, for "Canton's soup kitchen as holidays get closer and federal cuts loom," reported with David Sommerstein for North Country Public Radio
Co-author of a 2025 paper, "Post-Translational Modifications of Proteins Orchestrate All Hallmarks of Cancer" (Life 15:126; Clarkson University affiliation), published Jan 2025

Co-authored "Spatiotemporal changes in imaging features associated with diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis (DISH)" (RMD Open, 2024) with Michele C. Battié and Cheryle A. Séguin, affiliated with the University of Western Ontario
Named to the SUNY Plattsburgh Dean's List for Fall 2022, of North Lawrence, New York
Born in Augusta, Georgia, and raised in Grovetown, Georgia
